notes: Does not like Vice Headmaster Althair Veyne, which only entertains him.
Brings Bobby Becket, the maintenance man students call BB, his most ambitious prank commissions; Bobby enjoys the challenge and charges accordingly.
Irene Chanare is his nemesis; she is always one step from catching him and never has.
Gets Linus Tallyworth's column a day before it runs and sets his odds by it; when it is wrong, he lets Linus take the blame.

The Tally has been wrong twice this year, both times on a feat Nerys swore she had seen; Aiden paid out both times and has not yet worked out whom to blame.
